source: Read-only Lovable Supabase connector, Fenasoja project 756eeb64-0d44-4171-b445-f8a60f0492c0. Query selected cadastral/visual fields only; no buyer, payment, contract or logo URL.
query: select e.project_id,e.id as entity_id,l.id as lot_id,e.public_identifier,e.classification,e.is_sellable,e.is_archived,e.segment_id,s.slug as segment_slug,s.is_active as segment_active,l.block,l.lot_number,l.status,l.is_covered,l.archived_at,e.parent_entity_id,e.metadata->'entityType' as entity_type,e.metadata->'geometryRevision' as geometry_revision,e.metadata->'pavilionPublicIdentifier' as pavilion_public_identifier,e.metadata->'pavilionModuleKey' as pavilion_module_key,e.metadata->'moduleNumber' as module_number,e.metadata->'interiorOnly' as interior_only,e.metadata->'areaCode' as area_code,e.metadata->'labelAnchor' as label_anchor,l.official_area_sqm,g.id as geometry_id,g.geometry,g.elevation,g.extrusion_height,g.rotation,g.version as geometry_version,g.calibration_version from public.map_entities e join public.map_segments s on s.id=e.segment_id and s.project_id=e.project_id left join public.commercial_lots l on l.entity_id=e.id and l.project_id=e.project_id left join public.map_entity_geometries g on g.entity_id=e.id and g.is_current where e.project_id='0538d132-34dd-4347-a33c-526edac7339c' and s.slug='exporural' and not e.is_archived and (l.id is null or l.archived_at is null) order by e.public_identifier,e.id
